question_text: A 2-week-old infant is brought to the emergency room because of 4 episodes of bilious vomiting and inconsolable crying for the past 3 hours. An upper GI contrast series shows the duodenojejunal junction to the right of the vertebral midline; an air-filled cecum is noted in the right upper quadrant.         ### Question

An upper GI contrast series shows the duodenojejunal junction to the right of the vertebral midline; an air-filled cecum is noted in the right upper quadrant. Which of the following is the most likely cause of this patient's condition?

        ### Options

opb. Incomplete intestinal rotation
opc. Arrested rotation of ventral pancreatic bud
opd. Hypertrophy and hyperplasia of the pyloric sphincter
ope. Resorption of a small bowel segment
